premise: At daybreak Robot thinks the solar panel is dancing and copies its slow tilt step for step, and Robo-dog joins in.
inspiration: Ovid's Clytie, who turns all day to follow the Sun, turned into a dance lesson.
lesson: Copying a friend can turn into a good time, even when you've got it wrong.
learning: Solar panels turn to face the Sun, to catch as much light as they can.

en-US.title: The Dance of the Sun
en-US.text: {canvas:daybreak 10s} After the long, dark night, the Sun peeked over the ridge. {solar-panel:enter} The solar panel tilted its {solar-panel:live hold} face slowly up toward it. {robot:enter} Robot stared. {robot:face surprised} [curious] Is it… dancing? {robot:wobble} He tilted his head. {solar-panel:pulse} The panel tilted a little more. Solar panels turn to face the Sun, to catch as much light as they can. But Robot didn't know that. {robot:face happy} [excited] A dance class! {robot:live hold} He struck a pose, one arm up to the Sun. {robodog:enter} Robo-dog came trotting over, {robodog:face happy} and {robodog:live hold} sat up with his paws in the air. [giggles] And there they stayed, three dancers, perfectly still, {all:glow} soaking up the light. It was the slowest dance on the Moon. It lasted all day.

es-ES.title: El baile del Sol
es-ES.text: {canvas:daybreak 10s} Por fin se acabó la noche: el Sol asomó por la cordillera. {solar-panel:enter} El panel solar inclinó la {solar-panel:live hold} cara despacito hacia él. {robot:enter} Robot se quedó mirando. {robot:face surprised} [curious] ¿Está… bailando? {robot:wobble} Ladeó la cabeza. {solar-panel:pulse} El panel se inclinó un poco más. Los paneles solares se giran hacia el Sol para atrapar toda la luz que pueden. Pero Robot no lo sabía. {robot:face happy} [excited] ¡Una clase de baile! {robot:live hold} Se puso en pose, con un brazo hacia el Sol. {robodog:enter} Perro robot llegó trotando, {robodog:face happy} y {robodog:live hold} se sentó con las patas en el aire. [giggles] Y allí se quedaron, tres bailarines, quietos, quietísimos, {all:glow} empapándose de luz. Fue el baile más lento de la Luna. Duró todo el día.
